verdict.rationale: Vestd's own docs advertise a migration offering ('Migrate to Vestd – Digitise or move your existing scheme', plus a dedicated /migrate page), and the homepage pitches replacing messy spreadsheets with a reconciled single source of truth. That counts as a first-party capability for this story, but the evidence is thin marketing copy with no detail on how migration works. missing for 10: documented guided import workflow (e.g. spreadsheet template or other-platform importer), validation checks on imported data, reconciliation against source documents, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can migrate an existing cap table — from a spreadsheet or another platform — with guided import, validation, and reconciliation against source documents

citations.quote: Migrate to Vestd - Digitise or move your existing scheme
No more messy spreadsheets scattered across your team. One source of truth, reconciled.
